title: Define Python and Rust solver parity
context: Define how the Python solver and the Rust engine stay equivalent.

spec.summary: Define Python and Rust solver parity
spec.expected_outcome: Confirm the migrated scope and acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Fixtures are shared by both solvers.
Both produce the same solution for every fixture.
Both agree on valid, invalid, and ambiguous puzzles.
The source of truth is documented.
Move fixtures to a shared directory.
Both accept the same valid puzzle.
